findings.proposed: Use '#' in the four many arms: many {# de completadas}, many {# de fallidas}, many {# de detenidas}, many {# con estado desconocido}. Every other arm keeps the '::group-off' skeleton exactly as English.
findings.reason: The 'many' arms are es-authored (English has no category arms here) and exist because es CLDR puts exact millions in 'many' ('un millón de completadas'). Each one reuses the sibling arms' '::group-off' skeleton, so the only number that can reach it prints ungrouped: rendering completed=1000000 gives "1000000 de completadas". Spanish always groups, and the es style guide's own exemplar for this category is many {# de sesiones}, illustrated as "1.000.000 de sesiones". Verified: many {# de completadas} renders "1.000.000 de completadas". Real but unreachable in practice (>=1,000,000 requests in one sound batch), and a one-commit fix, hence MINOR rather than MAJOR.
findings.disposition: reported; does not gate (no BLOCKER/MAJOR)
findings.supplemental_evidence_disposition: Retained non-gating finding and original disposition unchanged. No new wording/semantics audit or edit; images do not adjudicate this language judgment.

findings.current: Coût estimé à 0 $ ; frais finaux non confirmés.
findings.proposed: Coût estimé à 0 $US ; frais finaux non confirmés.
findings.reason: Bare `$` is the only MONEY rendering in the shipped fr corpus (the three other fr values that contain a `$` are JavaScript template/code tokens — `${name}`, `$'{'NAME'}'` — not amounts; counted in audit.log). The corpus writes the currency as the ISO code after the amount (`ui.common.account.low_credits_dialog.detail` « {detail} USD », `ui.providers.phone.action.activate` « Activer pour {amount} USD par mois », `ui.providers.phone.consent` « … à {amount} USD par mois … »), and the runtime's own fr money formatter renders USD as `0,00 $US` (Intl.NumberFormat('fr', {style:'currency', currency:'USD'}).format(0) = "0,00\u00a0$US"). An unqualified `$` is read as CAD in a Canadian reading, while this is a USD billing sentence. Not MAJOR: the amount is zero, so no charge can be misread, and the sentence's real claim (estimate, not a confirmed bill) survives.
findings.disposition: retained, non-gating; no new remediation authorization
findings.retained_original_disposition: retained, non-gating; no new remediation authorization
